draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.36, the 34th-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 4th of 26 at LB. He went 33rd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing standouts: vertical jump (91st percentile). College production: his final season (2024) ranked 1st in tackles among the 25 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Cleveland Browns. 16 career games and 16 starts over 1 completed season, plus 4 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (8 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: tackles for loss 11 (98th percentile), combined tackles 156 (97th percentile), approximate value 8 (87th percentile). Versus the typical Year-1 off-ball linebacker who played: 156 combined tackles against a median of 23, above the norm.
